semantics.office_definition: A logical engineering office is a bounded responsibility and routing domain, not a physical office or an independently privileged agent. It coordinates systems, tools, contracts, evidence, and handoffs.
semantics.unverified_identity_rule: Repository-name similarity never resolves system identity. VLNS/NAXLNS and NEXNET/NEXENT remain separate unresolved mappings until explicit evidence is attached.
semantics.external_execution_boundary: External models, APIs, servers, repositories, databases, devices, and tools must pass the VAIXLNS Universal External Integration Gate and VX policy boundary before execution. This registry does not grant credentials or runtime authority.

offices.name: Canonical Governance & Master Registry Office
offices.purpose: Own canonical identities, policy references, architecture state, repository classification, and explicit admission records.
offices.authority_ceiling: May classify and prepare governance records; canonical promotion or runtime admission requires the defined governance and proof gates.
handoff_rules: No name-only merge or rename.
Every promotion must preserve source identity, evidence, version, and lineage.
Unknown evidence keeps the item in HOLD or UNVERIFIED.

offices.name: Research & System Discovery Office
offices.purpose: Discover sources, systems, tools, capability gaps, candidate architectures, contradictions, and evidence lineage.
offices.authority_ceiling: Research, retrieval, comparison, and proposal only; cannot self-admit research findings or modify canonical state.
handoff_rules: Cite source URI and revision when available.
Mark reconstructed/inferred claims distinctly from directly observed repository evidence.
Missing search adapters must produce NOT_CONFIGURED/HOLD, not invented results.

offices.name: Intelligence, Decomposition & Planning Office
offices.purpose: Translate intents and discoveries into decomposed tasks, typed plans, candidate solutions, and handoff envelopes.
offices.authority_ceiling: May plan and recommend; execution remains subject to VX capabilities, policy, and scoped authorization.
handoff_rules: Separate planning from execution.
Attach budget, expected state transition, risk, and evidence obligations to every executable proposal.
Do not treat agent consensus as proof.

offices.name: VX Execution & Runtime Office
offices.purpose: Provide the governed execution boundary for admitted actions, typed adapters, event/state/ledger effects, and controlled recovery.
offices.authority_ceiling: Only explicitly admitted operations with a valid capability contract, policy approval, resource budget, and required evidence hooks.
handoff_rules: No direct external action before VX policy gating.
Timeouts and partial failures must remain observable and resumable by stable task ID.
Physical-system adapters default to observe/simulate.

offices.name: Knowledge, Nexus & Lineage Office
offices.purpose: Maintain resolvable system, capability, file, artifact, evidence, dependency, and temporal relationships without losing legacy identities.
offices.authority_ceiling: Index and relationship maintenance only; cannot infer unresolved identity equivalence as canonical fact.
handoff_rules: Preserve aliases and historical IDs.
Use explicit relationship types rather than destructive merges.
Mark source gaps and identity conflicts in the graph.

offices.name: Verification, Evidence & Proof Office
offices.purpose: Check contracts, conformance, falsification cases, evidence freshness, reproducibility, and proof obligations.
offices.authority_ceiling: May verify and report; cannot grant its own execution authority or promote its own candidate.
handoff_rules: Evidence is not proof until obligations are checked.
A reachable endpoint is not evidence of service correctness.
Missing observations force an explicit unobservable/hold result.

offices.name: Operations, Observability & Recovery Office
offices.purpose: Correlate runtime health, events, state, ledger, replay, recovery, capacity, and operational assurance.
offices.authority_ceiling: Read/observe by default; recovery actions require explicit VX authority and runbook-defined scope.
handoff_rules: Use a shared trace/task ID across offices.
Record health, metrics, logs, evidence, and replay references consistently.
Do not label production-ready without deployment and runtime evidence.

offices.name: Security, Identity & Authority Office
offices.purpose: Define trust boundaries, identity bindings, least-privilege scopes, data classification, egress controls, and revocation paths.
offices.authority_ceiling: Policy evaluation and restricted grants only; secrets are never stored in this registry and no adapter can expand its own authority.
handoff_rules: Deny by default for write, financial, production, or physical actions.
Pin endpoint, version, environment, and contract for admissions.
Material changes invalidate prior admission and require revalidation.

offices.name: Repository Federation & Source Preservation Office
offices.purpose: Inventory known repositories, preserve their independent identities, classify architectural roles, and route integration through explicit contracts.
offices.authority_ceiling: Read and classify source repositories; write changes only through authorized branches and pull requests.
handoff_rules: Never merge or rename based on name similarity alone.
Keep legacy and external repositories untouched until content, lineage, and license/security are reviewed.
Green CI is implementation evidence, not production admission.

offices.name: Tool & Adapter Interoperability Office
offices.purpose: Normalize tool, API, MCP server, model, database, cloud, device, and repository interfaces behind typed contracts.
offices.authority_ceiling: Discovery and sandbox adapter implementation; no production credentials or unrestricted egress.
handoff_rules: Use one canonical request envelope across adapters.
Validate input and output schemas before results enter state.
Apply timeout, retry, rate/resource limits, egress policy, and revocation.
MCP is an interface protocol, not an admission or trust grant.

offices.name: Engineering, Build & Conformance Office
offices.purpose: Turn accepted specifications into reviewed implementation slices, automated tests, reproducible build evidence, and release candidates.
offices.authority_ceiling: Branch-scoped code generation and sandbox testing; no direct production deployment or canonical self-promotion.
handoff_rules: Use additive branches for integration changes.
Run format/schema/compile/unit/conformance checks.
Failures must remain visible; do not rewrite a failed test into a pass without evidence.

offices.name: Financial Feasibility & Resource Analysis Office
offices.purpose: Estimate engineering cost, resource budgets, pricing options, unit economics, and downside scenarios for proposed capabilities.
offices.authority_ceiling: Analysis and proposal only; no payments, account access, transfers, trades, or binding financial decisions.
handoff_rules: Label estimates and assumptions.
Provider prices and live market data require source and retrieval timestamp.
Transaction capability requires separate legal, security, and explicit authority gates.

offices.name: Multi-Platform Client & Session Office
offices.purpose: Expose a consistent operational contract across Linux, Windows, Android, desktop, and web clients without forking core authority.
offices.authority_ceiling: User interaction, monitoring, search, status, and approval requests; clients do not become canonical execution authorities.
handoff_rules: All clients use the same logical operations and identity model.
UI state is not canonical state.
Authenticated API gateway, event transport, and end-to-end conformance remain separate implementation requirements.

offices.name: Innovation, Genome & Architecture Synthesis Office
offices.purpose: Capture inventions and capability gaps, build candidate architecture/genome records, compare alternatives, and hand off evidence packages.
offices.authority_ceiling: Generate and evaluate candidates only; generator, judge, and authority remain separate responsibilities.
handoff_rules: Do not duplicate a concept before searching existing names and lineage.
Keep original formulations alongside normalized descriptions.
Promote only through VAIXLNS governance.

offices.name: Server, Cloud & Capacity Federation Office
offices.purpose: Map compute, service, server, deployment, capacity and connectivity surfaces to bounded runtime contracts.
offices.authority_ceiling: Read-only discovery and capacity planning by default; deployment/mutation requires separate approval and runtime evidence.
handoff_rules: GET-only probes do not scan subnets or execute remote commands.
A reachable server is not proof of a correctly functioning service.
Do not invent endpoints, server IDs, or live instances.

offices.name: Industrial, Robotics & Automotive Adapter Office
offices.purpose: Define bounded contracts for physical/embedded systems and require domain-specific hazard and safety validation.
offices.authority_ceiling: Observe/simulate only until a verified, domain-specific safety contract and explicit execution authorization are present.
handoff_rules: No actuation from discovery-only or unverified adapters.
Physical operations require timeout, interlock, safe-state, and recovery definitions.
Unknown device behavior forces quarantine.

systems.name: VAIXLNS
systems.role: Canonical architecture, governance, registry, recovery, and adoption authority.
systems.authority_boundary: Canonical adoption and governance; no capability is implicitly admitted merely because its design or registry record exists.
blockers: The historical 0001-2750 index still requires item-by-item source reconciliation before claiming complete archive extraction.

systems.name: NEXENT
systems.role: Independent discovery, architecture search, synthesis, verification support, and evolution-proposal engine.
systems.authority_boundary: May discover, design, compare, simulate, verify, and propose; VAIXLNS controls canonical adoption.
blockers: Specific executable components, runtime endpoints, and end-to-end conformance must be verified per implementation.

systems.name: VX Runtime
systems.role: Governed execution boundary and runtime contract.
systems.authority_boundary: Execution only after contract, policy, capability, environment, and admission checks.
blockers: This record does not assert that every integrated system is connected to a live VX instance.

systems.name: VAIXLNS-unified
systems.role: Integrated runtime/fabric implementation surface.
systems.authority_boundary: Implementation surface; canonical authority stays in VAIXLNS and runtime operations require evidence.
blockers: Implementation conformance and live runtime binding must be independently verified.

systems.name: vaixlns-core
systems.role: Focused sovereign-core vertical slice.
systems.authority_boundary: Bounded core implementation; no authority beyond its validated contract.
blockers: Exact conformance with the current canonical execution contract requires validation.

systems.name: vaixlns-csd-kernel
systems.role: Specialized signed/replayable kernel and DSL/compiler surface.
systems.authority_boundary: Specialized kernel surface admitted only through explicit contract and compatible evidence.
blockers: Cross-repository contract and replay conformance are not asserted by this registry.

systems.name: VLNS
systems.role: Independent system identity for knowledge/discovery/adversarial analysis.
systems.authority_boundary: No canonical identity reassignment, merge, or admission until equivalence evidence is approved.
blockers: VLNS ↔ NAXLNS is explicitly unresolved in the federation records.

systems.name: NEXNET
systems.role: Independent network/discovery system identity pending reconciliation.
systems.authority_boundary: No equivalence to NEXENT is inferred from similar naming.
blockers: NEXNET ↔ NEXENT requires explicit identity evidence; NEXENT remains a separately observed repository.

systems.name: VX Agents Fabric
systems.role: Specialist-agent orchestration for research, finance, engineering, and parent reviews.
systems.authority_boundary: Scoped proposal, research, sandbox, analysis, and review only; no production/canonical mutation or financial transaction authority.
blockers: Universal admission gate incomplete; provider configuration, live tool adapters, durable canonical ledger integration, replay, fresh proof, and production admission remain unproven.

systems.name: VAIXLNS Intent-to-Reality
systems.role: Intent, state, and transformation specification surface.
systems.authority_boundary: Specification/reference only unless a current implementation and contract are verified.
blockers: Exact deployed integration not established in the reviewed references.

systems.name: VAIXLNS Naming Constitution
systems.role: Naming and identity governance support.
systems.authority_boundary: Identity/naming constraints; does not independently grant runtime admission.
blockers: Current version-to-runtime policy bindings must be checked before implementation claims.

systems.name: VX50_COMPLETE_BUILD
systems.role: Historical/build surface retained for lineage and selective integration.
systems.authority_boundary: Historical source only until inspected and admitted through the integration gate.
blockers: No blind copy/rename or automatic canonical promotion.

systems.name: tunnel-client
systems.role: Connectivity/transport utility candidate.
systems.authority_boundary: Candidate transport adapter only; no assumed endpoint trust or network authority.
blockers: Repository-specific contract and security review required before use.

systems.name: NEXENT Multi-Platform Client Surface
systems.role: Shared operational contract for Linux, Windows, Android, desktop and web clients.
systems.authority_boundary: Clients request/observe/approve; core owns canonical state and execution.
blockers: Native clients, authenticated gateway, event transport, and end-to-end conformance remain pending per the interface document.

systems.name: ARC-X Ω
systems.role: Evidence, claim, verification-obligation and proof boundary.
systems.authority_boundary: Produces/validates proof artifacts but does not approve its own execution or canonical promotion.
blockers: A referenced contract or document is not by itself evidence that every proof engine is running.

systems.name: Canonical Nexus / LNS Knowledge Graph
systems.role: Canonical identity, capability, dependency, evidence, temporal and lineage relationship substrate.
systems.authority_boundary: Resolves and links records under schema; unresolved conflicts remain explicit and cannot be rewritten as facts.
blockers: Complete fragment-level indexing and 0001-2750 historical item reconciliation are not claimed by this seed.

systems.name: Operational Integrity Fabric
systems.role: Operational assurance, event/state/ledger/replay, recovery and readiness controls.
systems.authority_boundary: Operational evidence and recovery control; not consensus, not an identity authority, and not proof merely by existing.
blockers: Live telemetry, durable canonical ledger integration and production readiness must be proven for each runtime.

systems.name: XV Intelligence & Planning
systems.role: Reasoning, planning and decision preparation.
systems.authority_boundary: Prepares candidates and decision records; cannot bypass policy or perform unrestricted execution.
blockers: Implementation scope must be mapped to executable components before runtime claims.

systems.name: VV Verification & Validation
systems.role: Independent verification, conformance checking and proof-obligation evaluation.
systems.authority_boundary: Verification results remain separate from governance approval and implementation ownership.
blockers: Per-integration conformance evidence is required.

systems.name: Repository Federation Index
systems.role: Source inventory and role mapping for independently versioned repositories.
systems.authority_boundary: Catalog and role evidence only; no implicit merge or repo identity equivalence.
blockers: Inventory entries are not identical to full source-code audits of all repositories.

systems.name: Industrial / Robotics / Automotive Adapter Family
systems.role: Potential integration surface for physical and embedded systems.
systems.authority_boundary: Observe/simulate only until safety, isolation, authority, interlocks and recovery are proven.
blockers: No universal claim that any external device or vehicle is connected.

tool_integrations.name: Ω.000 Master Index Artifact

contract.retry_policy: No network retry for local registry reads.

security.data_boundary: Public repository metadata only; private user secrets are out of scope.

observability.evidence_capture: Record file revision or blob SHA when consumed.
observability.health: Verify file exists and parses before use.

blockers: Artifact availability is not proof that all historical 0001-2750 entries are present or reconciled.

tool_integrations.name: Repository Federation Inventory

contract.retry_policy: No network retry for local registry reads.

security.data_boundary: Repository metadata and explicit public source references.

observability.evidence_capture: Record registry revision and source refs.
observability.health: Parse inventory and check referenced paths.

blockers: Inventory completeness does not establish source-code review for every repository.

tool_integrations.name: NEXENT Architecture Search

contract.retry_policy: Retry only with the same task and source revision after transient failure.
contract.idempotency: Candidate generation must include a stable task ID and input lineage.

security.authentication: Repository/provider-specific authentication to be configured by deployment.
security.data_boundary: Only authorized research sources; secrets excluded from artifacts.
security.egress_policy: No live web/repository access until the corresponding adapters are configured and admitted.

observability.evidence_capture: Each claim links to source URI/revision or is marked inferred/unverified.
observability.replay: Replay requires pinned prompt/provider/source versions when applicable.
observability.health: No live search capability is assumed from design docs alone.

blockers: Live web-search and repository adapters are explicitly not included in the current agent-fabric contract.

tool_integrations.name: VX External Integration Admission Gate

contract.retry_policy: Do not retry a denied decision without a changed input/evidence revision.
contract.idempotency: Policy evaluation idempotent for a pinned input and policy version.

security.authentication: Invoker identity and explicit authority required by runtime.
security.data_boundary: Registry metadata and bounded request artifacts.
security.egress_policy: Gate does not authorize network egress by itself.
security.authority_ceiling: Admission decision only within configured policy; no self-promotion.

observability.evidence_capture: Pin contract, policy, environment, dependency fingerprint and proof digest.
observability.replay: Replay decision against recorded policy and evidence versions.
observability.health: Source presence and CI status must be checked before describing as running.

blockers: This registry does not prove the gate is deployed or wired to every runtime.

tool_integrations.name: Evidence-First Discovery Router

contract.retry_policy: Retry idempotently using the same discovery and route IDs.

security.authentication: Repository/runtime permissions; caller identity must be separately bound in deployment.
security.data_boundary: Source summaries, evidence references and route metadata.
security.egress_policy: No live research source is implied by the router itself.
security.authority_ceiling: Routes work and proposals; execution_authorization must remain false.

observability.evidence_capture: Store source refs, evidence status, conflict and route history.
observability.replay: Deterministic routing tests and stable route IDs.
observability.health: Validate schema and run the repository conformance workflow.

blockers: Live provider/search integrations remain separate adapters.

tool_integrations.name: Read-Only Server Discovery Probe

contract.retry_policy: Bounded retries only when configured; no target expansion.

security.authentication: No credentials by default; use explicit allowlist.
security.egress_policy: GET-only checks; no subnet scanning, redirect following, or remote command execution.
security.authority_ceiling: Observation only; reachability does not assert service correctness.

observability.evidence_capture: Record target, time, response status, bounds and error.
observability.replay: Replay stored observation; live request is not deterministic.
observability.health: Probe is available only when the script and its tests are present in the selected revision.

blockers: Each target requires explicit authorization; no unknown endpoints are inferred.

tool_integrations.name: ARC-X Evidence/Proof Boundary

contract.retry_policy: Re-evaluate after a missing or stale evidence item changes.
contract.idempotency: Pin artifact and policy versions for deterministic re-check.

security.authentication: Bounded verifier identity required in runtime.
security.data_boundary: Evidence references and authorized artifacts only.
security.egress_policy: No implicit browsing or secret retrieval.

observability.evidence_capture: Store claim-to-evidence mapping and verifier/version identity.
observability.replay: Replay against pinned source revisions and verification rules.
observability.health: Documentation alone does not imply an executable proof service.

blockers: Executable proof-engine scope and independent run evidence must be attached per integration.

tool_integrations.name: GitHub Repository API Adapter

contract.retry_policy: Bounded backoff for transient errors; no retries on permission denial.
contract.idempotency: Read requests idempotent; writes require branch+path+expected revision and pull request.

security.authentication: Installation or fine-grained token with least privilege; never embed token in registry.
security.data_boundary: Repository paths, metadata and authorized source code.
security.egress_policy: Pinned GitHub domains and repository allowlist only.
security.authority_ceiling: Read-first; all writes branch-scoped and reviewable; no direct canonical promotion.

observability.evidence_capture: Record repo, ref, path, blob/commit SHA, API result and task ID.
observability.replay: Replay reads from pinned revisions; writes are never replayed blindly.
observability.health: NOT_CONFIGURED until deployment credentials, scopes and integration tests are recorded.

blockers: The existence of a GitHub connector in another application does not mean a repository adapter is connected to VX runtime.

tool_integrations.name: Web Search & Source Capture Adapter

contract.retry_policy: Bounded retry for transient responses only.
contract.idempotency: Queries are identified by task ID, query and retrieval time.

security.authentication: Provider-specific credentials managed outside source registry.
security.data_boundary: Public or explicitly authorized sources only.
security.egress_policy: Domain allowlist and rate limits required.

observability.evidence_capture: Store URL, title, retrieved_at, content digest when permitted and uncertainty.
observability.replay: Cached source snapshots where licensing permits; otherwise live replay is non-deterministic.
observability.health: No live web capability is assumed until an approved provider adapter is connected.

blockers: Search provider, license constraints, retrieval storage and live conformance tests are not bound in the reviewed agent-fabric contract.

tool_integrations.name: Isolated Code Build/Test Sandbox

contract.retry_policy: Retry only infrastructure faults with identical immutable input; never retry destructive commands automatically.
contract.idempotency: Inputs pinned by commit and environment fingerprint.

security.data_boundary: Disposable worktree and synthetic or approved data.
security.egress_policy: Network disabled by default; explicit per-task egress allowlist.
security.authority_ceiling: Build/test only; no production secrets, deployments or canonical writes.

observability.evidence_capture: Capture immutable input ref, environment fingerprint, command, exit code, and artifact digests.
observability.replay: Repeatable when dependencies and environment are pinned.
observability.health: NOT_CONFIGURED until isolation and negative tests are demonstrated.

blockers: The current provider bindings are not a code sandbox; process/container isolation is not proven by this registry.

tool_integrations.name: Model Context Protocol Tool Adapter

contract.retry_policy: Retry only safe idempotent requests with same request ID.
contract.idempotency: Each call carries server identity, tool name, version and request ID.

security.authentication: Transport and server authentication required; protocol conformance alone is not trust.
security.data_boundary: Minimize data passed to tools; classify tool results as untrusted until validated.
security.egress_policy: Explicit server allowlist; no automatic network discovery.
security.authority_ceiling: Only individually admitted tools and capabilities.

observability.evidence_capture: Record server and tool identity, schema version, request ID, result digest and policy decision.
observability.replay: Replay from stored request/result envelopes when safe.
observability.health: Requires protocol conformance, auth tests, malicious-output tests and VX gate integration.

blockers: No statement that a general MCP gateway is connected to this VX runtime.

tool_integrations.name: OpenTelemetry-Compatible Observability Adapter

contract.retry_policy: Drop or buffer within bounded limits; do not block critical execution indefinitely.
contract.idempotency: Signals are keyed by trace/span and source event identifiers.

security.authentication: Collector credentials and transport security configured per environment.
security.data_boundary: Telemetry must redact secrets and sensitive payloads.
security.authority_ceiling: Observe and report; no execution control authority.

observability.evidence_capture: Trace ID, span ID, resource/service identity and schema version.
observability.replay: Replay stored events or traces; live timing cannot be reproduced exactly.
observability.health: No live OTel export is claimed by this registry.

blockers: Instrumentation, collector endpoint, data redaction and runtime trace-context propagation remain to be implemented and verified.

tool_integrations.name: NEXENT Authenticated API/Event Gateway

contract.retry_policy: Client-generated idempotency key for submitted intents.
contract.idempotency: Session and intent IDs remain portable between platforms.

security.authentication: Strong client/session identity and scoped authorization required before implementation.
security.data_boundary: Only authorized user and session data.
security.egress_policy: No direct client-to-tool bypass around core policy.
security.authority_ceiling: Request, observe, search, and submit approval; no canonical client-side mutation.

observability.evidence_capture: Link session, intent, request, event and evidence IDs.
observability.replay: Resume using canonical session and event identifiers.
observability.health: The NEXENT source explicitly marks authenticated gateway and event transport as pending.

blockers: Authenticated API gateway, event transport and end-to-end conformance remain pending.

tool_integrations.name: Database / File / Stream / Vector / Graph Data Adapter

contract.retry_policy: Bounded retry for idempotent reads; writes require separate capability and approval.
contract.idempotency: Read query plus source revision forms a request identity.

security.authority_ceiling: Read-only by default; mutation needs a separate contract.

observability.evidence_capture: Source identity, schema/version, query hash and result digest.
observability.replay: Replay from authorized snapshot or transaction/time boundary when available.
observability.health: No database, file store or data platform is assumed connected.

blockers: Concrete connector, credential scope, schema and replay semantics must be provided per source.

tool_integrations.name: Cloud / Deployment / Capacity Adapter

contract.retry_policy: Bounded retries for read operations only.
contract.idempotency: Resource observations pinned by environment and retrieval time.

security.data_boundary: Resource metadata only unless separately approved.
security.authority_ceiling: Read/plan only until explicit deployment authority is granted.

observability.evidence_capture: Provider, account/project alias, region, resource identity and retrieval timestamp.
observability.replay: Replay saved plan/observation; live control state is time-sensitive.
observability.health: No cloud account or server deployment is inferred from architecture files.

blockers: No provider account, endpoint, credentials, environment fingerprint or deployment test evidence attached.

tool_integrations.name: Industrial / Embedded Device Adapter

contract.retry_policy: No automatic retries for actuator/write commands.
contract.idempotency: Read-only probes keyed by device and observation window; actions require explicit idempotency behavior.

security.authentication: Device-specific identity, network segmentation and per-capability grants.
security.data_boundary: Telemetry and synthetic simulation by default.
security.authority_ceiling: Observe/simulate only until verified safety proof and explicit authorization.

observability.evidence_capture: Device identity, firmware/protocol version, interlock state and safety evidence.
observability.replay: Simulation replay required; live actuator commands are not replayed automatically.
observability.health: Unconfigured until safety and physical integration tests pass.

blockers: No physical device connection or actuator authority is claimed.

tool_integrations.name: ROS / Robotics / Simulation Adapter

contract.retry_policy: Retries are bounded and disabled for non-idempotent actuator actions.
contract.idempotency: Simulation run pinned by model, world, seed and action plan.

security.authentication: Authenticated robot/simulator identity and scoped control.
security.authority_ceiling: Simulation and observation only until validated safety admission.

observability.evidence_capture: Model/world/seed, state estimate, action plan and safety outcomes.
observability.health: No live robot endpoint is inferred.

blockers: No robot, ROS graph, simulator or execution credentials are connected by this registry.

tool_integrations.name: Mobile / Desktop / Browser Client Adapter

contract.retry_policy: Submit with idempotency key; retry reads within bounded limits.
contract.idempotency: Client-generated request ID and canonical session ID.

security.authentication: User identity and session authorization are required.
security.data_boundary: Only user-authorized view and action-request data.
security.egress_policy: No direct tool/server access from UI code.
security.authority_ceiling: UI and intent submission only; core enforces policy and state.

observability.evidence_capture: Client version, request ID, session ID and server response ID.
observability.replay: Session continuation through canonical session/event IDs.
observability.health: Native clients and gateway are not marked implemented by this spec.

blockers: The interface document lists clients as specified and gateway/event transport as pending.

edges.boundary: Canonical identity and admission remain in VAIXLNS.
NEXENT candidate -> evidence package -> VAIXLNS governance; no direct canonical promotion.
VX executes only under canonical contract, policy and admission controls.
Runtime events and evidence feed operational assurance; deployment must prove the actual binding.
Recovery proposal is policy-gated and must not bypass runtime authority.
MCP tool server discovery does not imply trust or execution admission.
Inventory is a source map, not proof of complete source-code audit.
Routing cannot set execution_authorization true or promote a candidate.
Verification reports admission obligations; no self-approval.
Clients share one protocol; client UI never becomes canonical state.
Observe/simulate only until safety proof and explicit authority exist.
Observability improves traceability but does not grant execution authority.
Build/test is isolated; no production mutation or credential inheritance.

not_claimed: This is not a complete extraction of every historical item from the 0001-2750 master index.
This registry does not prove every described tool, office, agent, provider, server, database, client, or device is deployed or live-connected.
The registry does not authorize execution, canonical promotion, financial transactions, production deployment, or physical actuation.
Repository identity equivalence for VLNS/NAXLNS and NEXNET/NEXENT remains unresolved.
External adapters marked NOT_CONFIGURED remain disconnected until endpoints, credentials, permissions, tests and admission evidence are attached.
